INSERT INTO hosts (
                owner_user_id,
                shared_with_organization_id,
                machine_id,
                name,
                status,
                agent_version
            )
            VALUES ($1, NULL, $2, $3, 'offline', $4)
            ON CONFLICT (owner_user_id, machine_id) DO UPDATE
                SET name = EXCLUDED.name,
                    agent_version = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.agent_version, hosts.agent_version),
                    updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE hosts.auth_mode = 'legacy_pairing'
                    AND hosts.remote_access_enabled AND hosts.deleted_at IS NULL
            RETURNING id AS "id!: Uuid"
